title: 2022年12月 第1套

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Operations at one of Australia's largest gold mines had to be temporarily suspended on Friday after a partial wall collapse at one of the mines dams.
lines.translation: 周五,澳大利亚最大的金矿之一因其中一座尾矿坝发生部分坝体垮塌而不得不暂时停止运营。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The wall collapse at the Cadia mine came just a few days after two earthquakes hit the area.
lines.translation: Cadia矿区的坝体垮塌发生在该地区遭受两次地震袭击后仅数天。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The damage to the dam wall was noticed in the late afternoon on Friday when workers found a section of the northern dam wall had collapsed into the southern dam.
lines.translation: 周五傍晚,工作人员发现北坝的一段坝体已坍塌至南坝中,从而注意到坝体受损。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The dams contain waste products of mining and can contain materials which are harmful to the environment and human health.
lines.translation: 这些尾矿坝容纳采矿废弃物,可能含有对环境和人类健康有害的物质。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The dams are generally constructed using earth-fill and are gradually raised over time.
lines.translation: 这些尾矿坝通常采用土石填筑建造,并随时间逐步加高。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The company was unable to confirm whether the recent earthquakes had contributed to the dam's wall collapse, but said it was conducting a thorough investigation.
lines.translation: 该公司无法确认近期地震是否导致了坝体垮塌,但表示正在进行彻底调查。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: A company spokesperson said the operations at the site had been halted while the investigation is ongoing and that the break had posed no safety threat to workers.
lines.translation: 公司发言人表示,在调查期间该矿区的运营已被暂停,且此次坝体坍塌未对工作人员构成安全威胁。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 1. What happened at one of Australia's largest gold mines?
lines.translation: 第 1 题：澳大利亚最大的金矿之一发生了什么？

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 2. What did the spokesperson say about the incident?
lines.translation: 第 2 题：发言人对这一事件说了什么？

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: News report 2.
lines.translation: 《新闻报告2》。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Two boys and four girls were born on Monday to the surprise of a young couple and doctors who had expected five babies.
lines.translation: 周一,一对年轻夫妇和原本预期会有五个婴儿的医生们惊讶地迎来了两个男孩和四个女孩的诞生。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Two boys and four girls were born on Monday to the surprise of a young couple and doctors who had expected five babies.
lines.translation: 周一,一对年轻夫妇和原本预期会有五个婴儿的医生们惊讶地迎来了两个男孩和四个女孩的诞生。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: This was the first record of six babies being born at the same time in that region.
lines.translation: 这是该地区首次有六个婴儿同时出生的记录。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The doctors prepared from early in the morning to help deliver five tiny citizens.
lines.translation: 医生们从清晨就开始准备协助接生五个小公民。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: They were in the operating room with five teams of doctors, one for each baby.
lines.translation: 他们在手术室里准备了五组医生团队,每个婴儿配备一组。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The first five babies were delivered successfully, and all baby beds were occupied.
lines.translation: 前五个婴儿成功分娩,所有婴儿床都被占用了。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: And then all of a sudden, it turned out there was another waiting to come out.
lines.translation: 然后突然之间,发现还有另一个婴儿等待出生。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The doctor said the babies were in healthy condition, but could not go home immediately.
lines.translation: 医生表示婴儿们健康状况良好,但不能立即回家。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: They needed to stay in the hospital for two to three months for medical supervision.
lines.translation: 他们需要在医院接受两到三个月的医学监护。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The mother who is in stable condition could return home a day later if all physical tests came back normal.
lines.translation: 状况稳定的母亲如果所有体检结果正常,一天后就可以回家。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The babies' mother commented that they had already prepared room for five babies at home, so they will have to rearrange things for their happy surprise.
lines.translation: 婴儿的母亲表示他们已经在家里为五个婴儿准备了房间,所以他们必须为这个惊喜重新安排。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The new parents have yet to name the sixth baby but are considering either Lily or Rose.
lines.translation: 这对新父母尚未给第六个婴儿取名,但正在考虑Lily或Rose。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 3. What did the hospital do for the delivery of the babies?
lines.translation: 第 3 题：医院为婴儿的分娩做了什么?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 4. What did the doctor say about the newborns?
lines.translation: 第 4 题：医生对新生儿说了什么?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: A Spanish island called Palmador has been bought by a family from Europe for 18 million euros.
lines.translation: 一座名为Palmador的西班牙岛屿已被一个欧洲家族以1800万欧元购得。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The island is often described as heaven on earth by holidaymakers.
lines.translation: 这座岛屿常被度假者形容为人间天堂。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: For decades tourists have been flocking to Palmador, which is located off the southeast coast of Spain.
lines.translation: 数十年来，游客纷纷涌向位于西班牙东南海岸外的Palmador岛。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: They come to enjoy its unspoiled beaches and crystal clear waters.
lines.translation: 他们来此享受未受破坏的海滩和清澈见底的海水。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Its natural beauty is protected as it lies inside a natural park.
lines.translation: 由于该岛位于自然公园内,其自然美景受到保护。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Although Palmador is one of the most famous private islands in the world, its seafront is public land and is a favorite destination for famous people.
lines.translation: 尽管Palmador是世界上最著名的私人岛屿之一,但其海滨属于公共土地,是名人最喜爱的目的地。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: When the island was put up for sale, it was offered to the local government but proved too expensive for the local authorities.
lines.translation: 当该岛挂牌出售时,曾提供给当地政府,但对当地政府来说价格过于昂贵。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: It is unclear whether the new owners have the power to ban tourists from the island.
lines.translation: 目前尚不清楚新业主是否有权禁止游客登岛。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: But with their newfound luxury comes the responsibility for its protection and maintenance.
lines.translation: 但随着新获得的奢华享受,他们也肩负着保护和维护该岛的责任。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The island is less than two miles long and half a mile wide.
lines.translation: 该岛长度不到两英里,宽度半英里。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: It is said to have a remarkable location that few other private islands of this size can match, according to estate agents.
lines.translation: 据房地产经纪人称,该岛拥有卓越的地理位置,少有其他同等规模的私人岛屿能与之媲美。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Palmador is the perfect place to retreat to, somewhere to get away from the city noise and relax in beautiful surroundings with zero stress.
lines.translation: Palmador是完美的隐居之地,可以远离城市喧嚣,在美丽的环境中放松身心,毫无压力。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 5. What do we learn from the news report about the Spanish island Palmador?
lines.translation: 第 5 题：从新闻报道中我们了解到关于西班牙岛屿Palmador的什么信息?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 6. What do holidaymakers come to Palmador to enjoy?
lines.translation: 第 6 题：度假者来Palmador享受什么?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 7. What do estate agents say about Palmador?
lines.translation: 第 7 题：房地产经纪人对Palmador有何评价?

lines.translation: B节,方向 在本节,你会听到两个长长的谈话。

lines.text: At the end of each conversation,
lines.translation: 每次谈话结束时

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Hi, Christie's Gym Center.
lines.translation: 你好,Christie's健身中心。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: How can I help you?
lines.translation: 有什么可以帮您的?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Hi, I'm calling to ask about the newly scheduled gym classes.
lines.translation: 你好,我打电话是想问一下新安排的健身课程。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: I'm just wondering if I can get a discount on them.
lines.translation: 我想知道能不能打折。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Are you already a member?
lines.translation: 您已经是会员了吗?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Yes, I signed up two months ago, but I haven't been to any of the group classes yet.
lines.translation: 是的,我两个月前注册的,但还没参加过任何团体课程。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Can I take your name please?
lines.translation: 能告诉我您的名字吗?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Yes.
lines.translation: 可以。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: My name is Carol Friedman.
lines.translation: 我叫Carol Friedman。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Carol Friedman.
lines.translation: Carol Friedman。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: That's right.
lines.translation: 没错。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: And you signed up two months ago.
lines.translation: 您两个月前注册的。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Currently we are offering existing members discounts off two of our brand new classes, hot yoga, and advanced spinning, but the discount doesn't apply to any of our regular classes I'm afraid.
lines.translation: 目前我们给现有会员提供两门全新课程的折扣,高温瑜伽和高级动感单车,但折扣恐怕不适用于我们的常规课程。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: I'm only interested in the new classes.
lines.translation: 我只对新课程感兴趣。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: So how much of a discount is there on these two new classes?
lines.translation: 那这两门新课程有多少折扣?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The same discount of 20% is being offered to everyone at the door on a "first come, first served" basis for the first month.
lines.translation: 第一个月所有人在门口都能享受同样的8折优惠,先到先得。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: It's a shame you missed out on the general discount.
lines.translation: 很遗憾您错过了普遍折扣。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: I see.
lines.translation: 我明白了。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: But you can get 25% off if you sign up in advance.
lines.translation: 不过如果您提前报名可以享受75折。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Which of the two classes are you thinking about?
lines.translation: 您考虑这两门课程中的哪一门?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Well, I guess I am only really interested in hot yoga.
lines.translation: 嗯,我想我只对高温瑜伽真正感兴趣。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Can you sign me up for the 10-week course on Thursday evenings?
lines.translation: 能帮我报名周四晚上的10周课程吗?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Sure.
lines.translation: 当然。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Would you prefer to pay in advance?
lines.translation: 您愿意提前付款吗?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: No, I don't like giving my card details over the phone anyway.
lines.translation: 不,反正我不喜欢在电话里提供银行卡信息。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Okay, then.
lines.translation: 好的。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: As you are already a member, the fee of the class will just be added to your monthly bill.
lines.translation: 因为您已经是会员了,课程费用会直接加到您的月账单上。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: That's perfect.
lines.translation: 太好了。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Thanks for your help.
lines.translation: 谢谢你的帮助。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: See you Thursday.
lines.translation: 周四见。

lines.translation: 第 11 题：为什么这位女士不愿意提前付款?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Conversation 2.
lines.translation: 对话2。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Well, I think that was quite a successful trip in the end.
lines.translation: 嗯，我觉得这次出差最后还是挺成功的。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Don't you think, Jenny?
lines.translation: 你觉得呢，Jenny？

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Absolutely.
lines.translation: 当然了。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: There are lots of great potential markets here in China.
lines.translation: 中国这边有很多很好的潜在市场。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: So I'm sure that the head office in London will be pleased once we get back and present our research.
lines.translation: 所以我相信我们回去向伦敦总部汇报研究结果时，他们会很满意的。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Okay.
lines.translation: 好的。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: We've got a bit of spare time now.
lines.translation: 我们现在还有点空闲时间。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Can we discuss the return trip to the head office?
lines.translation: 能讨论一下回总部的行程吗？

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Sure.
lines.translation: 当然。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: I've checked the availability of flights from Beijing to London on the 22nd and you have a choice.
lines.translation: 我查了22号从北京到伦敦的航班，你有两个选择。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: There's a flight arriving the following morning, with a two-hour stopover in Dubai, or a flight arriving at 11:30 in the evening, with a five-hour stopover in Amsterdam.
lines.translation: 一个是第二天早上到达的航班，在Dubai转机两小时；另一个是晚上11点半到达的航班，在Amsterdam转机五小时。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Right.
lines.translation: 好的。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Well, that's obvious then, isn't it?
lines.translation: 那很明显了，不是吗？

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: okay, so that's Dubai.
lines.translation: 好的，那就是Dubai那班。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: I've booked a room in a hotel about a mile from the office.
lines.translation: 我在离办公室大约一英里的酒店订了房间。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The nearest metro station is Earl's Court.
lines.translation: 最近的地铁站是Earl's Court。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Great.
lines.translation: 太好了。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Can you find a map that shows where the hotel is and send it to me online?
lines.translation: 你能找张显示酒店位置的地图发给我吗？

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: I've never been to the head office, you know.
lines.translation: 你知道的，我从没去过总部。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: I want to see if I can get one of those rental bicycles and ride to the office just for fun.
lines.translation: 我想看看能不能租一辆自行车骑到办公室，就当娱乐一下。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: For the presentation, I'll bring my own laptop and hook it up to their projector.
lines.translation: 演示的话，我会带自己的笔记本电脑，接到他们的投影仪上。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Do you remember the capacity of their meeting room?
lines.translation: 你记得他们会议室能容纳多少人吗？

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: No, but I'll check.
lines.translation: 不记得了，但我会查一下。

lines.text: Just one more thing.
lines.translation: 还有一件事。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: I'll pay everything with my own card, right?
lines.translation: 所有费用我都用自己的卡付，对吧？

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: And I'll submit my claims form afterwards.
lines.translation: 然后之后再提交报销单。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: No problem.

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Just remember to keep all your receipts.
lines.translation: 只要记得保留所有收据就行。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: You remember the trouble you had last time.
lines.translation: 你还记得上次遇到的麻烦吧。

lines.translation: 一项新研究证明了女性权利的重要性。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The researchers behind the study state that many parts of the world have made good economic progress, but women's rights are often overlooked.
lines.translation: 该研究的研究人员指出,世界许多地区取得了良好的经济进步,但女性权利往往被忽视。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Thus, they wanted to determine if there was a link between protection of women's rights and public health.
lines.translation: 因此,他们想确定女性权利保护与公共健康之间是否存在联系。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The researchers analyzed databases which held information from 162 countries for the period 2004 to 2010.
lines.translation: 研究人员分析了包含162个国家2004年至2010年期间信息的数据库。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Countries were classified according to the respect they gave to women's economic and social rights.
lines.translation: 国家根据其对妇女的经济和社会权利给予的尊重加以分类。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: There were three categories.
lines.translation: 分为三类。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: They were high, moderate, and poor.
lines.translation: 他们是高、温和、贫穷的。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Analysis of the data showed that countries with strong women's rights had better health than those where women's rights were not as respected.
lines.translation: 数据分析显示,女性权利保障强的国家比那些不太尊重女性权利的国家拥有更好的健康状况。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The health indicators studied included disease prevention, reproductive health, death rates, and life expectancy.
lines.translation: 研究的健康指标包括疾病预防、生殖健康、死亡率和预期寿命。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Furthermore, in countries where women's rights were most respected, but where access to hospitals and doctors was below average, health outcomes were still better than in countries rated as moderate or poor.
lines.translation: 此外,在最尊重女性权利但医院和医生资源低于平均水平的国家,健康结果仍然优于被评为中等或低的国家。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: This confirms that even with a lack of resources, if a country has strong women's rights, the health outcomes are better.
lines.translation: 这证实了即使在资源匮乏的情况下,如果一个国家拥有强有力的女性权利保障,健康结果也会更好。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Thus, the researchers argued that gender equality is not just a women's rights issue.
lines.translation: 因此,研究人员认为,两性平等不仅仅是妇女权利问题。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: It is also a development issue.
lines.translation: 它也是一个发展问题。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: This is because better health aids economic development.
lines.translation: 这是因为改善健康有助于经济发展。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: They note that the value of women's rights has often been questioned from an economic standpoint.
lines.translation: 他们指出,从经济角度来看,妇女权利的价值经常受到质疑。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Some have argued that ensuring those rights would limit progress, but this study indicates the opposite.
lines.translation: 一些人认为,确保这些权利会限制进展,但本研究报告指出情况恰恰相反。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 16. What did the researchers of the new study try to determine?
lines.translation: 第 16 题：这项新研究的研究人员试图确定什么?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 17. What does the passage say about countries lacking in medical resources?
lines.translation: 第 17 题：关于缺乏医疗资源的国家,文章说了什么?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 18. What has often been questioned regarding women's rights?
lines.translation: 第 18 题：关于妇女权利,什么经常受到质疑?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Sunshine and high temperatures can mean picnics and parks and trips to beaches, but they can make your body react in some strange ways.
lines.translation: 阳光和高温可能意味着野餐、公园和海滩之旅,但它们也会让你的身体产生一些奇怪的反应。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: First, sunshine can actually affect your breath.
lines.translation: 首先,阳光实际上会影响你的口气。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: You may think that summer is the perfect time to go on a date or chat with an attractive boy or girl.
lines.translation: 你可能认为夏天是约会或与有魅力的男孩或女孩聊天的完美时机。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: But excessive heat can cause you to lose water, which has been proven to have a pretty unattractive side effect—bad breath.
lines.translation: 但过度的高温会导致你失水,而这已被证明会产生一个相当不讨人喜欢的副作用——口臭。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: When you are lacking water, your mouth becomes dry.
lines.translation: 你们缺水的时候,口干口干。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Bacteria accumulate because there isn't enough water in your mouth to wash it away, Sunshine can stop you from sweating, too.
lines.translation: 细菌累积是因为你嘴里的水 不足以洗掉它 阳光也能阻止你出汗

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The body's normal temperature is 36 to 37 degrees centigrade.
lines.translation: 身体的正常温度是36到37摄氏度

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: But if it heats up to 40 to 41 degrees, you may find yourself getting heatstroke.
lines.translation: 但是如果温度高达40到41度 你可能会发现自己在中暑

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: At that point, your heat regulatory system can essentially quit, which stops you from sweating as your body tries to keep water around your vital organs.
lines.translation: 那时,你的热调控系统基本上可以戒烟, 从而阻止你出汗, 当你的身体试图保持水 围绕你的关键器官。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: However, the sun can have a positive influence on your body by raising your energy levels.
lines.translation: 然而,阳光可以通过提高你的能量水平对你的身体产生积极影响。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: You might feel like the sun is giving you extra energy for your day, which is actually happening.
lines.translation: 你可能会觉得阳光给你的一天带来了额外的能量,而这确实正在发生。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: And vitamin D from sunshine can help your body to absorb certain minerals, which are linked to building stronger bones.
lines.translation: 而且来自阳光的维生素D可以帮助你的身体吸收某些矿物质,这些矿物质与增强骨骼有关。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Therefore, I suggest you spend more time in the park with your friends, but make sure you apply lots of skin protection and fill up those water bottles, too.
lines.translation: 因此,我建议你多花时间和朋友在公园里,但一定要涂抹大量的防晒保护,也要把水瓶装满。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 19. What does the passage say about hot sunshine?
lines.translation: 第 19 题：文章关于炎热的阳光说了什么？

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 20. What does the passage say is a negative side effect of water loss?
lines.translation: 第 20 题：文章说水分流失的负面副作用是什么？

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 21. What is said to be a positive effect of sunshine?
lines.translation: 第 21 题：阳光的积极作用是什么？

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 3. Left-handed people can find it inconvenient to do certain things, writing in a notebook, for example.
lines.translation: 左撇子会发现做某些事情很不方便, 例如写在笔记本上。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Left-handed people can find it inconvenient to do certain things, writing in a notebook for example, but there are a number of advantages of being left-handed.
lines.translation: 左撇子在做某些事情时可能会感到不便,比如在笔记本上写字,但左撇子也有许多优势。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Research found that they were overrepresented among fighters in combat sports.
lines.translation: 研究发现,在格斗运动中,左撇子的比例过高。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Left-handed fighters also had higher chances to win.
lines.translation: 左撇子选手获胜的机会也更高。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: This confirms the fighter theory.
lines.translation: 这证实了战斗理论。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Left-handers may also be better at remembering events.
lines.translation: 左撇子在记忆事件方面可能也更出色。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The explanation is that the two brain spheres of left-handers are more strongly connected.
lines.translation: 解释是左撇子的两个大脑半球联系更紧密。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Being left-handed might be a factor in mathematical ability.
lines.translation: 左撇子可能是数学能力的一个影响因素。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: An Italian study found that for simple arithmetic there was little difference between right- and left-handed performance, but for more difficult problem-solving, left-handers won out.
lines.translation: 一项意大利研究发现,在简单算术方面,左撇子和右撇子的表现差异不大,但在更困难的问题解决方面,左撇子胜出。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: No one understands the reason for this.
lines.translation: 没有人理解其中的原因。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Left-handed people may think differently.
lines.translation: 左撇子的思维方式可能有所不同。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: In one study, researchers showed the participants columns of abstract illustrations and asked them which ones they would prefer.
lines.translation: 在一项研究中,研究人员向参与者展示了几列抽象插图,并询问他们更喜欢哪些。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Left-handed people were more likely to prefer the images on the left.
lines.translation: 左撇子更可能喜欢左边的图像。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Right-handed people preferred the ones on the right.
lines.translation: 右撇子更喜欢右边的图像。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Both groups disliked stuff on their opposite side.
lines.translation: 两组人都不喜欢相反一侧的东西。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Left-handers are also overrepresented in professional, interactive sports.
lines.translation: 左撇子在职业互动性运动中也占比过高。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Researchers have looked at the influence of being left-handed on performance and interactive sports.
lines.translation: 研究人员研究了左撇子对互动性运动表现的影响。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Those that require the fastest reaction give left-handers the biggest advantage.
lines.translation: 那些需要最快反应的运动给左撇子带来最大优势。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: So if you have a left-handed child, you should encourage them to play table tennis, baseball and tennis.
lines.translation: 因此,如果你有一个左撇子孩子,你应该鼓励他们打乒乓球、棒球和网球。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Being left-handed maximizes their chances of success in these sports.
lines.translation: 左撇子最大化了他们在这些运动中的成功机会。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Questions 22-25 are based on the passage you have just heard.
lines.translation: 问题22-25是根据你刚才听到的段落提出的。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 22. What does the passage say about left-handed people?
lines.translation: 第 22 题：文章关于左撇子说了什么?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 23. What is said to be special about left-handed people?
lines.translation: 第 23 题：据说左撇子有什么特别之处?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 24. Why are left-handed people better at solving more difficult problems?
lines.translation: 第 24 题：为什么左撇子更擅长解决更困难的问题?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 25. What should parents do about a left-handed child?
lines.translation: 第 25 题：父母应该如何对待左撇子孩子?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: That's the end of listening comprehension
lines.translation: 听觉理解到此结束
